body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Piercing Damage and prevent the target from moving through your space until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Pull it 1 unit after the bite.
The target must burn 1 die before voluntarily moving away from you until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Mandibles (upkeep 1): your first Gestalt hit against an adjacent enemy each turn may make it Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
